data.description: Container that renders a comparison table from a referenced inline JSON config block.

data-aed-compare-source.description: DOM id of a <script type='application/json'> block holding the table data.

json.description: Table content. Cell values 'yes' / true / '✓' render as green check; 'no' / false render as gray dash; 'partial' / '~' render as amber dot; anything else renders as text.

columns.description: Column headers. Each: { label: string, you?: boolean }. Mark the brand's own column with `you: true` for accent styling.

rows.description: Row entries. Either a feature row { label: string, values: any[] } (one value per column) or a section header { section: string }.
